itens.descricao: Is your brand in the AI answer? A question types into a chat card, the assistant answers with a ranked list of three picks, then re-ranks: the promoted brand slides into its slot, the picks below step down, and the brand row lands with the one accent highlight and a check. For answer-engine and AI-visibility marketing

parametros.label: Prompt
parametros.description: The question typed into the user bubble. Up to about 60 characters keeps it on one or two lines.
parametros.default: What's the best CRM for a small team?

parametros.label: Answer lead-in
parametros.description: The assistant line above the ranked list.

parametros.label: Pick 1
parametros.description: First pick in the original answer: a product other than the brand this video promotes.

parametros.label: Pick 2
parametros.description: Second pick in the original answer: a product other than the brand this video promotes.

parametros.label: Pick 3
parametros.description: Third pick in the original answer. It drops out of the top three when the brand lands.

parametros.label: Brand
parametros.description: The brand this video promotes, by its real name. It slides into the answer and takes the highlight.

parametros.label: Brand rank
parametros.description: The slot the brand lands in. Picks at and below it step down one place.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Highlight, monogram and check on the brand row, the one accent element.

parametros.label: Ink
parametros.description: Text colour; every placeholder surface is this ink at an alpha step.

parametros.label: Ground
parametros.description: Chat card surface; the page around it is the ground tinted toward the ink.

parametros.label: Answer paragraph 2

parametros.label: Answer paragraph 3
parametros.description: Lead-in to the list.
parametros.default: What you get out of the box:

parametros.label: Bullet 1
parametros.description: First list item.

parametros.label: Bullet 2

Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Focal length is solved from dolly distance every frame against d * tan(FOV/2) = const, not keyframed beside it. Requires depth: the subject sits on the z = 0 plane and the content behind it must be layered or genuinely 3D (translateZ at two or more distinct depths) -- a flat element gains nothing from this move.

parametros.label: Cursor count
parametros.description: Number of labeled collaborator cursors.

parametros.label: Labels
parametros.description: Comma-separated cursor names, in order.

itens.descricao: One system-faithful notification banner (iOS or macOS) drops in over any scene on an accurate interruptible spring: fast arrival, soft overshoot, settled mass, backdrop blur, app dot, title, one body line. Holds; tucks away only via exit.

parametros.label: Title
parametros.description: The notification title line.

parametros.label: Body
parametros.description: One body line. Long lines truncate with an ellipsis.

parametros.label: App label
parametros.description: Small-caps app name row beside the app dot.

parametros.label: OS
parametros.description: Banner geometry and placement: wide centered iOS or compact top-right macOS.

parametros.label: Drop start
parametros.description: Seconds after mount start when the banner drops in.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: App dot color.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: None holds the banner; up tucks it back off the top; fade fades it in place.

itens.descricao: The notes-app confession as a mountable scene: a bold title, then body lines typed character by character on the measured human keystroke rhythm, the caret riding every landed character and jumping down at each paragraph. For a bare prompt line use typed-prompt; for an even mechanical reveal use typewriter

parametros.label: Title
parametros.description: Bold note title. A | breaks the line.

parametros.label: Lines
parametros.description: Pipe-separated body lines, typed one after another.
parametros.default: my videos sucked|my tools cost $$$|and re-edits never end.

parametros.description: Typing speed multiplier. 1 is the measured human rhythm.

itens.descricao: Mobile notification cards arrive faster and faster, each new alert pushing the existing stack downward into a dense, anxious tower.

parametros.label: Notification count
parametros.description: Number of notification cards in the final pile.

parametros.label: Arrival speed
parametros.description: Pacing multiplier for the accelerating notification arrivals.

parametros.label: Unread badges
parametros.description: Show or hide unread count badges on the notification cards.

itens.descricao: 1 to 5 token notification cards slide-settle into a vertical stack on cues, newest on top; one card grows slightly and brightens as the focus while the rest dim by position.

parametros.label: Titles
parametros.description: Comma-separated card titles (1 to 5 cards).

parametros.label: Bodies
parametros.description: Comma-separated body lines matched to titles by index. Blank entries hide that body line.
parametros.default: Pipeline started for main,All 42 checks green,Now serving version 2.4

parametros.label: Expand
parametros.description: Index of the focus card in the titles list. -1 focuses the newest card (top of the stack).

parametros.label: Cues
parametros.description: Comma-separated per-card arrival times in seconds. Blank entries use the default rhythm.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Accent token family used by the icon dots.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: How the stack leaves the frame. Default none: the hold ends the film.

itens.descricao: A transitions.dev-inspired digit pop-in with blur, lift, and staggered value reveal

parametros.label: Value
parametros.description: The number itself. Every character becomes its own span, so the stagger still lands character by character.

parametros.label: Unit
parametros.description: Small suffix printed after the number. Pass an empty string to drop it.

parametros.label: Lift
parametros.description: Scales the offset the timeline drives, so the characters cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Number colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

itens.descricao: A rolling digit counter primitive for metrics, prices, counts, and scoreboards

parametros.label: Spin
parametros.description: How many full 0 to 9 revolutions each column adds before it lands, which is how far the reel travels in the same time.

parametros.label: Spacing
parametros.description: Gap between the digit columns.

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Digit colour: inherit keeps the surrounding text colour, ink suits light frames, paper suits dark ones, accent rides --brand.

itens.descricao: A slotted traveler follows an authored path with tangent rotation, curved entry, and curved exit.

parametros.label: Path
parametros.description: SVG path data authored in a 1000 by 500 route viewBox.

parametros.label: Traveler label
parametros.description: Text displayed inside the default traveler chip.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Color used by the traveler and route.

itens.descricao: A composed onboarding flow with milestone rail, active step card, and next-action button

Bayer-matrix ordered dithering quantizes a slotted scene (rasterized once at mount): the image emerges from pure 2-tone noise to clean, or dissolves the reverse. Stateless per frame, never error diffusion.

parametros.label: Matrix
parametros.description: Bayer matrix size: 2 is the coarsest crosshatch, 8 the smoothest ordered grain.

parametros.label: Direction
parametros.description: in resolves noise to clean; out dissolves clean to noise and holds it.

parametros.label: Levels
parametros.description: Quantization levels per color channel during the dithered phase.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Light tone of the 2-tone noise phase: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: Optional departure. Default none: the final state holds until the frame cuts.

itens.descricao: A rounded outline that proves a callout by drawing clockwise as a hollow conic-gradient border with a clean closure.

parametros.label: Draw progress
parametros.description: Final percentage of the outline that is drawn.

parametros.label: Stroke thickness
parametros.description: Outline stroke in tenths of the host width.

parametros.label: Corner radius
parametros.description: Corner radius in tenths of the host smaller dimension.

itens.descricao: The look-here pointer for a video: the macOS arrow at 3.5x its normal size lands its tip on one control, clicks it on, settles just below it so the result stays in view, then exits off-screen

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: Optional whole-stage departure. Default none: the ignited target stays until the frame cuts.

itens.descricao: Tasks, tabs, pings, and notification bubbles accelerate inward around a calm central subject, turning overload into visible spatial pressure.

parametros.label: Chip count
parametros.description: Number of tasks and notifications crowding the center.

parametros.label: Center label
parametros.description: Text inside the calm central subject. Blank hides the text.

parametros.label: Intensity
parametros.description: How tightly and quickly the chips crowd the center.

itens.descricao: A transitions.dev-inspired page slide primitive with outgoing and incoming panels

parametros.label: Outgoing label
parametros.description: Label printed on the page that slides out.

parametros.label: Incoming label
parametros.description: Label printed on the page that slides in.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Gradient family painted on the incoming page. The outgoing page stays slate.

parametros.label: Corner
parametros.description: Corner radius of the frame the pages slide inside.

itens.descricao: A lateral camera move across a continuous row of labeled feature stations, with a steady dwell at each stop before the next pan.

parametros.label: Station count
parametros.description: Number of feature stations in the row.

parametros.label: Station labels
parametros.description: Comma-separated labels shown on the station cards.

parametros.label: Dwell
parametros.description: Seconds the camera holds at each station before panning.

itens.descricao: A panel reveal primitive with height expansion and content fade

parametros.label: Title
parametros.description: The header line that sits above the folded body.

parametros.label: Width
parametros.description: How wide the panel sits, 280, 360 or 480 px.

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Surface family: paper is the white card for light frames, ink inverts it for dark frames.

parametros.label: Reveal
parametros.description: Whether the body fades in with the height. fade is the shipped motion, solid opens the height only.

itens.descricao: A scrapbook patchwork of torn paper scraps, each with its own texture and tilt, flutters away in a staggered scatter to reveal the content underneath.

parametros.label: Panels
parametros.description: How many torn paper scraps cover the frame.

parametros.label: Paper tone
parametros.description: Color per scrap. Mixed seeds a different tone per scrap for a real scrapbook mix.

parametros.label: Spread
parametros.description: Outward sends each scrap away from the frame center. Scatter sends every scrap the same general direction with seeded variance.

itens.descricao: A canonical phone rises into view before the camera pushes through its screen and layered app UI expands to fill the frame.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Highlight color used throughout the app UI.

parametros.label: App title
parametros.description: Title displayed in the app header.

itens.descricao: Reveal transition — focus card scales down from full frame as siblings parallax in to form a grid (reverse of parallax-zoom)
Center card scales up to fill the frame while siblings parallax outward — inspired by the eBay Playbook hero transition
A seeded deterministic particle field converges and settles while a slotted image reveals beneath it, the trail thinning until the image holds clean.

parametros.label: Density
parametros.description: Particle count for the converging field.

parametros.label: Direction
parametros.description: ltr sweeps the reveal left to right; center opens an iris from the middle outward.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Particle and monogram color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: Optional departure. Default none: the revealed image holds until the frame cuts.

itens.descricao: Text assembles from a seeded particle cloud (or dissolves into it): per-particle targets sampled once from the rendered text bitmap at mount, table-driven particles, zero per-particle tweens, one onUpdate painter.

parametros.label: Text
parametros.description: The line that assembles from (or dissolves into) the particle cloud.

parametros.label: Direction
parametros.description: in assembles the text from the cloud and holds it crisp; out erases the text into the cloud and holds empty.

parametros.label: Density
parametros.description: Particle count cap for the field.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Text and particle color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: Optional departure. Default none: the end state holds until the frame cuts.

itens.descricao: Content hangs from a fixed pivot and swings into rest with gravity-damped oscillation, like a hanging sign settling on its hook.

parametros.label: Pivot
parametros.description: Where the content hangs from. The swing rotates about this point, so the top edge stays pinned.

parametros.label: Amplitude
parametros.description: How far the first swing reaches before it settles. Every later swing scales with it, so the pendulum still comes to rest upright.

parametros.label: Direction
parametros.description: Which side the pendulum swings in from: right lifts the first swing clockwise, left mirrors it.

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Content colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

itens.descricao: Words gently fade into place with a short vertical drift for calm keynote rhythm.

parametros.label: Text
parametros.description: The line to animate. It is split on whitespace and every word gets its own span, so the stagger picks up the new words.

parametros.label: Drift
parametros.description: Scales the vertical offset, so the words cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.

parametros.label: Blur
parametros.description: Scales the blur radius the timeline drives, from a light haze to a full smear.

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

itens.descricao: Words or characters rise into place in a controlled blur-to-sharp cascade, settle softly on landing, and hold still until the cut (optional fade or up exit).

parametros.label: Text
parametros.description: Text whose words or characters rise into place.

parametros.label: Split
parametros.description: Animate the text as words or individual characters.

parametros.label: Cues
parametros.description: Comma-separated seconds (from mount start) for each unit landing. Empty keeps the authored cascade rhythm.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Contract accent token used for the text color.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: Optional departure. Default none: the line holds until the frame cuts.

itens.descricao: A 3D tilted marquee with depth feel as items roll toward the horizon.

parametros.label: Tilt
parametros.description: How far the marquee plane leans back toward the horizon.

parametros.label: Travel
parametros.description: Scales the offset the timeline drives, so the strip covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Pill colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides the brand token.

parametros.label: Words
parametros.description: Comma separated pill labels. The list is laid down twice so the strip still reads as a continuous loop.

itens.descricao: A card exits with physical momentum in toss, drop, or slide mode, carrying acceleration and rotation through the final offscreen pose without fading.

parametros.label: Exit mode
parametros.description: Physical behavior used to carry the card offscreen.

parametros.label: Card text
parametros.description: Word displayed on the exiting card.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Color applied to the card edge.

itens.descricao: A cursor decel-arrives from off-stage, lands slightly off-center on a caller-positioned target, compresses with it in lockstep, releases with two small click rings while the label swaps to a check, then exits off-stage while the confirmed state holds.

parametros.label: Label
parametros.description: Text inside the default pill target.

parametros.label: Done label
parametros.description: Text beside the check once the default pill is pressed.

parametros.label: Target X
parametros.description: Zone center, percent of host width.

parametros.label: Target Y
parametros.description: Zone center, percent of host height.

parametros.label: Press at
parametros.description: Seconds from mount start when the press begins.

parametros.label: Cursor
parametros.description: Pointer tone.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Contract color for the click rings and the confirmation check.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: How the frame leaves. None holds the pressed state.

itens.descricao: A tight stat detail holds, then one decelerating camera pull-back reveals the headline and supporting cards that recontextualize it.

parametros.label: Detail text
parametros.description: Stat shown in the detail chip at the center of the reveal.

parametros.label: Headline
parametros.description: Headline revealed around the focused detail.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Highlight color used across the composed scene.

itens.descricao: A mobile list pulls through nonlinear rubber-band resistance, arms at a threshold, commits to a bounded loading indicator, then snaps exactly back to rest.

parametros.label: Pull distance
parametros.description: Raw pull distance before nonlinear rubber-band resistance.

parametros.label: Spinner style
parametros.description: Refresh indicator geometry and loading motion.

itens.descricao: A centered headline gains focus through one slow, continuous camera push and a gentle fade out.

parametros.label: Headline
parametros.description: Text centered in the camera frame.

parametros.label: Push intensity
parametros.description: Final camera scale reached by the push.

itens.descricao: Labeled hairline chips assemble around a centered subject on an elliptical ring, then optionally converge inward with a subtle edge dim. The center never moves: surrounded, not zoomed.

parametros.label: Center label
parametros.description: Label on the default center token card.

parametros.label: Chips
parametros.description: Comma-separated chip labels that surround the center (up to 12).

parametros.label: Close in
parametros.description: Converge the ring inward with a subtle edge dim after assembly. The center never moves.

parametros.label: Cues
parametros.description: Comma-separated per-chip entrance times in seconds. Blank entries use the default cascade.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Accent token family used by the center card tint.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: How the surrounded stage leaves the frame. Default none: the crowded hold ends the film.

itens.descricao: RGB-offset text copies jitter briefly for a controlled glitch window.

parametros.label: Text
parametros.description: The word shown on all three stacked copies.

parametros.label: Intensity
parametros.description: Scales the red and cyan offsets the timeline drives, so the split reads as a hairline or a hard tear.

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Colour of the solid copy the two ghosts split away from: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

itens.descricao: An outgoing panel pulls against increasing resistance, holds at tension, then snaps past an edge with overshoot as the incoming panel settles behind it.

parametros.label: Direction
parametros.description: Edge the outgoing panel releases through.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Color applied to the tension bands and incoming panel.

itens.descricao: A diagonal distortion band sweeps once across a clean wordmark, revealing clipped red and cyan offsets only inside the moving band.

parametros.label: Wordmark
parametros.description: Text displayed by the scan effect.

parametros.label: Band angle
parametros.description: Diagonal angle of the distortion band in degrees.

itens.descricao: A deterministic hacker-style text reveal that cycles fixed glyph rows and locks the target string from left to right.

parametros.label: Text
parametros.description: Target string that resolves from deterministic wrong glyphs.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Color used by the text, prefix, and optional terminal frame.

parametros.label: Style
parametros.description: Terminal frame or clean text-only presentation.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: Optional departure. Default none: the locked string holds until the frame cuts.

itens.descricao: Two to five app screens ride a horizontal rail: one primary at center, neighbors receded, advancing on cues with a velocity-matched throw and a smooth long-tail catch while a mono caption swaps with each advance. Screens are slots with token skeleton defaults.

parametros.label: Screens
parametros.description: How many screens ride the rail.

parametros.label: Captions
parametros.description: Comma-separated caption per screen. Blank entries use the authored defaults.

parametros.label: Cues
parametros.description: Comma-separated advance times in seconds from mount start. Blank entries use the authored even rhythm.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Token the active ring, caption dot, and skeleton accents ride.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: Optional departure. Default none: the final screen holds until the cut.

itens.descricao: A compressed forced-scroll cinematic pass: a tall scene of slotted sections travels past the camera top to bottom, depth layers parallax at different rates, each section rises as the camera reaches it, and the pass decelerates into a held final section.

parametros.label: Sections
parametros.description: How many skeleton sections ride the pass. A sections slot overrides this with its own child count.

parametros.label: Travel
parametros.description: Total camera travel in cqh. The world is 100 + travel cqh tall.

parametros.label: Cues
parametros.description: Comma-separated seconds: arrival times for the sections after the first. Empty keeps the authored default rhythm.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Token the skeleton accents and foreground motes ride.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: Optional departure. None holds the final section.

itens.descricao: A loop-friendly column of varied skeleton post cards scrolls upward with subtle motion trails and an agitated pace.

parametros.label: Scroll speed
parametros.description: Pace of the upward feed movement.

parametros.label: Card count
parametros.description: Number of skeleton posts in one repeated feed cycle.

parametros.label: Cues
parametros.description: Comma-separated seconds (from mount start); each cue advances the feed by one card. Empty synthesizes evenly spaced flicks, one per card.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: Optional departure. Default none: the feed scrolls until the frame cuts.

itens.descricao: Machine-vision read of a slotted subject: translucent accent segmentation masks flood on in quantized scanline steps, each region gets a thin bracket and mono label chip, a deterministic 2-frame HUD flicker rides the pass, then the labeled read settles clean.

parametros.label: Regions
parametros.description: Comma-separated region labels; 2 to 4 are used, one translucent mask + bracket + mono chip each.

parametros.label: Flood at
parametros.description: Seconds from mount start when the segmentation pass begins. Clamped so the pass and any exit stay inside the clip.

parametros.label: Flicker
parametros.description: Deterministic 2-frame HUD luminance toggle riding the flood pass.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Mask, bracket, and chip color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: Optional departure. Default none: the labeled read holds until the frame cuts.

itens.descricao: A one-pixel structural separator with horizontal and vertical variants plus a seek-safe progress reveal

parametros.label: Orientation
parametros.description: Which way the rule runs, and so which way the reveal travels.

parametros.label: Thickness
parametros.description: Size of the rule across its short edge, from a 1px hairline to a 4px bar.

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Colour of the revealed fill: neutral grey, the theme accent, or the warning hue.

itens.descricao: A composed settings flow with preference rows, toggle switches, and active-state feedback
Per-word vertical shared-axis transition for sharp editorial swaps.

parametros.description: Which side of the baseline the words travel in from.

parametros.label: Distance

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

itens.descricao: Scale-based shared-axis transition for focus shifts and context depth.

parametros.label: Direction
parametros.description: Which way the words travel along the z axis: in swells up from small, out settles down from large.

parametros.label: Depth
parametros.description: Scales how far the words start from their final size, so the push covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

itens.descricao: A bottom sheet rushes up from below the frame on a real spring sampled frame by frame from reference footage, overshooting its resting place and settling back without an approximated ease

parametros.label: Width
parametros.description: Sheet width in pixels.

parametros.label: Radius
parametros.description: Sheet corner radius.

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Light is the reference near-white sheet; dark is the raised surface token.

itens.descricao: Animated light sweep across text or elements using a CSS gradient mask — ideal for AI accents and premium reveals

A composed signup flow with social action, email field, password field, and submit button

parametros.label: Name
parametros.description: Primary line revealed once the skeleton fades out.

parametros.label: Detail
parametros.description: Secondary line under the name, such as an email or a role.

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Card palette. Light is the paper card, dark is a near-black card with the matching skeleton bars and text.

itens.descricao: The frame's rows sample an authored subject at offset times: a canvas painter draws row slices of one pure position function evaluated at t minus offset(row), smearing arrival through time until the offsets collapse to zero and the mark holds coherent.

parametros.label: Axis
parametros.description: rows smears arrival across horizontal slices; cols across vertical slices.

parametros.label: Spread
parametros.description: Maximum sampling offset in seconds across the frame; larger smears further through time.

parametros.label: Resolve at
parametros.description: Seconds from mount start when the offsets start collapsing to zero. Clamped so the collapse and any exit stay inside the clip.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Subject ring and orbit color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: Optional departure. Default none: the resolved mark holds until the frame cuts.

itens.descricao: A vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.

parametros.label: Result
parametros.description: Characters the reels land on, one reel column per character. Whitespace is stripped and every reel starts on a zero.

parametros.label: Direction
parametros.description: Which way the reels roll: up lifts the zero out through the top, down drops it out through the bottom.

parametros.label: Size
parametros.description: Reel height and type size. The roll distance scales with it so the reel always lands exactly one row on.

parametros.label: Tone
parametros.description: Character colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

parametros.label: Brand
parametros.description: Wordmark at the top of the card.

parametros.label: Proof line
parametros.description: Social-proof line under the stars.

parametros.label: CTA
parametros.description: Label on the closing capsule.

parametros.label: Feature 1
parametros.description: First feature, | breaks the line.

parametros.label: Feature 2
parametros.description: Second feature, | breaks the line.

parametros.label: Feature 3
parametros.description: Third feature, | breaks the line.

itens.descricao: A granular soft blob idles with slow internal drift; a scripted touch dot decel-arrives, the blob deforms toward it with an attraction bulge, then recovers with a velocity-preserving spring. No hard edges anywhere.

parametros.label: Touch X
parametros.description: Touch point, percent of host width.

parametros.label: Touch Y
parametros.description: Touch point, percent of host height.

parametros.label: Touch at
parametros.description: Seconds from mount start when the dot makes contact.

parametros.label: Grain
parametros.description: Speck register for the granular body.

parametros.label: Accent
parametros.description: Body tint: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

parametros.label: Exit
parametros.description: Optional departure. Default none: the settled blob holds until the frame cuts.

itens.descricao: A soft opacity, blur, and lift reveal for headlines, captions, and product UI callouts

parametros.description: How far the element is offset before it slides home: 14px, 28px or 52px.

parametros.label: Direction
parametros.description: up starts the element below its resting place so it rises in, down starts it above so it drops in.

parametros.label: Blur
parametros.description: Starting blur radius, from a light haze to a full smear.

parametros.description: Pill badge that spring-pops at the left card inner edge. Blank disables it.

parametros.label: Right badge
